title: MPOS | How to Complete a Drop-off Delivery
description:
In this video, you will learn how to mark an assigned drop-off order as successfully delivered in the MPOS Rider App.

The tutorial explains the complete delivery confirmation process, ensuring that order statuses are updated accurately and customers receive timely service.

Download the App - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.quickdrycleaning.qdcpos
